Findings.Question: Q10
Findings.Defect: load_json accepts NaN, Infinity and -Infinity through json.loads' default parse_constant behavior, although these tokens are not JSON values. A token in a field not subsequently inspected, such as Attempt, does not cause any failed check. Preserving all inspected identity and scope fields therefore leaves a malformed evidence document able to reach PASS and exit 0 for an otherwise valid synthetic delivery. Duplicate-key rejection and strict UTF-8 decoding do not reject these constants. The committed 25-case self-test has no regression for this path.
Findings.Authority: A-3:95,98 adopts A-2 condition 8 at line 87 and A-1 Sec.3 at lines 97-105: parsing/evidence ambiguity must fail closed and inputs must be JSON. Owner mandate clause 4 requires unambiguous evidence and fail-closed handling. INITIATIVE_LIFECYCLE Sec.5 makes a defective frozen guarantee REQUIRED.
Findings.Correction: Pass a parse_constant callback that raises ValueError for NaN, Infinity and -Infinity. Add synthetic behavioral regressions for both delegation and handoff, placing the tokens in otherwise uninspected fields and requiring DELEGATION_UNREADABLE or HANDOFF_UNREADABLE with nonzero exit. Demonstrate those regressions failing against the authorized A-3 verifier and passing after correction. Preserve prior A-n and evidence; authorize the corrected blob and updated self-test through the next append-only A-n and review that exact object before use, as A-2:115-116 requires.
